meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 会把 Matrix 适配器复制进 src/channels、注册并安装固定版本的依赖、修补 matrix-js-sdk 的 ESM 导入，然后跑构建和测试，让 NanoClaw 能接入任意 Matrix 服务器；同时引导你创建并配置一个独立的机器人账号。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Matrix 频道，或在 /setup 流程中需要接入 Matrix 房间、私聊时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建和测试

say.text: 帮我配置 Matrix 机器人的账号凭据
say.note: 会依次问 homeserver 地址、用户 ID 和认证方式

say.text: Matrix 构建报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，帮我修
say.note: 会重跑 ESM 扩展名补丁再构建

howto.what_en: Copies the Matrix adapter into src/channels, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then builds and tests, so NanoClaw can connect to any Matrix homeserver. Also guides a separate bot-account setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw, or during /setup when wiring Matrix rooms or DMs.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and tests
Prompts for homeserver, user ID and auth method

say_en.text: Fix the Matrix build ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND error
